text.id: deepfake3-With generative models evolving at breakneck speed, the task of detecting altered multimedia is a massive engineering challenge. The detection landscape is split into two main camps. Traditional-based methods focus entirely on pixel-level techniques, hunting for microscopic inconsistencies left behind during the forgery process.

deepfake3-On the other side are the DNN-based methods, which leverage deep neural networks to analyze complex spatial and temporal features. By extracting Sensor Pattern Noise (SPN) from a pre-processed face image and running it through a linear Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier, engineers can actively scan for the invisible digital artifacts that deepfakes inherently produce.
